# Generated Files

Generated output is reproducible build state, not source of truth.

## Authoritative inputs

Edit and review:

- `project.yml` for Xcode targets, settings, dependencies, and bundle layout;
- `Config/*.xcconfig` and checked-in entitlements for build policy;
- Swift sources, tests, scripts, fixtures, and public documentation; and
- package manifests under `Packages/`.

Brand artwork is a deliberate checked-in export exception. The supplied PNGs
under `Resources/Branding/Sources/` and `scripts/generate-brand-assets.py`
produce the reviewed SVG/PNG/ICNS exports and `Resources/WALIAssets.xcassets`.
Keep those exports in source control so building the app requires only Xcode,
not illustration tools. Regeneration instructions and source fidelity checks
are in [the branding guide](design/2026-09-09-wali-branding.md).

Do not edit a generated project or plist to make a persistent change.

## Generated and ignored

- `WALI.xcodeproj/` is generated by XcodeGen.
- `Config/Generated/` contains generated target `Info.plist` files.
- `.build/`, `build/`, `DerivedData/`, package `.build/`, and package `.swiftpm/`
  are local build state.
- `xcuserdata/` and `*.xcuserstate` are developer-local Xcode state.

These paths stay ignored and out of reviews. If generated output disagrees with
source, fix the authoritative input and regenerate.

## Commands

```bash
make generate
make build
make test
make verify
make clean
```

`make generate` resolves the supported XcodeGen executable and recreates the
project. `make clean` removes every repository-local generated project and
build output. Build and test scripts regenerate before invoking Xcode.

After changing `project.yml`, configuration, package products, or bundle
metadata, run focused checks followed by `make verify`. Release bundle checks
also run with:

```bash
CONFIGURATION=Release ./scripts/build.sh
CONFIGURATION=Release ./scripts/verify-bundle.sh
```

## Fixtures and reports

Golden compatibility fixtures are reviewed source artifacts even if a helper
created their initial bytes. Update them only through the versioning process;
never overwrite an old version fixture.

Local benchmark output, diagnostics, videos, screenshots, and scratch planning
logs are not source unless a plan explicitly names a sanitized artifact to
check in. Durable plans belong under `docs/plans/`; curated research belongs
under `docs/research/`.
